purpose: verified SPY cash dividends for the FREEZE Paper benchmark (SPY total return, never the S&P 500 Total Return index)

entry_fields.amount_usd: cash amount per share in USD, copied from source_url; null until verified
entry_fields.source_url: https URL of the named source the amount was read from
entry_fields.verified_on: YYYY-MM-DD date the amount was checked against source_url

rule: only add amounts read from a named source; an in-window or receipt-listed ex-date without a verified amount makes the benchmark INCONCLUSIVE_BENCHMARK
